prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle gain and strength improvement through weightlifting

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day with adequate protein (minimum 1.6g per kg bodyweight)
Pre and post-workout nutrition is specified with timing and macronutrient composition
Plan is presented in compact format (1 day only) with clear meal times and food items
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength-focused athlete (weightlifter) emphasizing protein intake, meal distribution for muscle recovery, and pre/post-workout nutrition

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with a 20-mile run scheduled for afternoon

solution_criteria: Meal plan includes 4-5 eating occasions with carbohydrate-dense meals totaling 3000-3500 calories
Pre-run meal (2-3 hours before afternoon run) and post-run recovery meal are specified with appropriate timing
All meals are compact and presented in a single-day format
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring calorie-dense, carbohydrate-heavy meals with specific timing around training

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain energy and performance for competitive soccer match in the evening

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre-game snack for a single day
All meals and snacks are vegan with adequate plant-based protein sources (legumes, tofu, nuts, seeds)
Plan provides sustained energy appropriate for an athlete with evening match performance goal
Plan is concise and practical to execute
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific dietary constraint (vegan soccer player) requiring plant-based protein sources while maintaining energy levels for competitive performance
